Valuation technique:
Items of property, plant
and equipment in Kenya
and Tanzania, other than
motor vehicles, are revalued
every 3 to 5 years, at values
determined based on a
valuation done by Ms Accurate
Valuers Limited on 29th March
2022. Accurate Valuers Limited
is an accredited independent
valuer, and an industry
specialist in valuing these
types of investment properties.
The fair value of the properties
has not been determined on
transactions observable in the
market because of the nature
of the property and lack of
comparable data. Instead,
valuation model in accordance
with that recommended by
the International Valuation
Standard Committee has been
applied.
The resulting fair value change
is dealt with through other
comprehensive income.
Significant unobservable inputs:
The factory buildings are
in prime locations within
the industrial area.
Machinery is anchored in
the factory buildings and
is specialized in cable
manufacturing only.
Other items of property,
plant and equipment like
motor vehicles, furniture
and fittings is moveable
in nature and is used to
facilitate manufacture
and sale of electrical
cables and conductors.
Inter-relationship between significant u:
The management
adopted the revalued
amounts based on
expert assessment.
Changes in values of
items of property, plant
and equipment were
effected through the
revaluation reserve.
